17483.d: The mind altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Mind Rune Temple, which is used to craft mind runes from rune essence or pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players can enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A mind talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A mind tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A mind talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in an armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a mind altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use a Goblin village sphere or Archaeology teleport to Goblin Village, exit the village south and go north-east to the altar.
• Use Home Teleport to the Falador lodestone and go north to the altar.

17539.d: The Mining Guild is a free-to-play guild which requires level 60 Mining to enter.
17539.loc: Southern section of the Dwarven Mine

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Members with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape to teleport directly into the Mining Guild.
• Members may use a skills necklace to teleport themselves to the ladder just above the Mining Guild.
• The Falador Teleport will transport a player to the Falador town square, just to the north-west of the guild entrance.
• The Keldagrim minecart system can be used to travel to the north-west corner of the Dwarven Mines. From there, players are able to follow the mines south until they reach the below-ground Mining Guild entrance.
• The cabbage-port function of the explorer's ring 3 and 4 lands the player in the cabbage field to the south east of the city, from which point they can run to the guild.
• If one of the boss portals in War's Retreat is attuned to the Giant Mole, then players can enter the portal to teleport to Falador Park and then run south-east to the guild.
